default/30730.htm.text: Bodyguard Jax: Traveler, sir. My name is Jax. I receive money and sell my swordsmanship. That is, my job is to protect children of nobles like you. Ah? You're not a noble person? So what! I am currently working under Trader Rolento over there. There are some neat things, have a look around.

Q00225_TestOfTheSearcher/30730-01.html.text: Bodyguard Jax: Royal Guards of the Lord? Gold of Prince Ashiton? What are you talking about? Are you drunk?

links.text: Show him the Map of Rambert

Q00225_TestOfTheSearcher/30730-02.html.text: Bodyguard Jax: You have not found the other portions of the Map yet. Was there something else you wanted to know?
